title: Yggdrasil wood

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Yggdrasil wood is a different type of wood used in late game building and crafting recipes. It is obtained exclusively from the Mistlands biome.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Acquired by chopping Yggdrasil shoots in the Mistlands. Requires Black metal axe or better to acquire.
• Can also be found in small amounts from destroying certain structures in the Mistlands.

sections.heading: Building

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Yggdrasil wood cannot be fed into a Charcoal kiln.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Presumably, both Yggdrasil shoots and Ancient Roots have been severed from the trunk of the Great Tree that players can see in the sky of Valheim. Munin implies that the Yggdrasil is an ash tree.
